quickAnswer: Cleaning a 12,000 sq ft mid-rise US office averages $816 to $1,446 per visit at 5x/week ($17,991–$31,306/month) and $873 to $1,518 per visit at 3x/week ($11,349–$19,734/month) on commercial carpet with five restrooms at the 1.00x national average (or $11,154–$19,344/month at 3x/week with four restrooms). At the 10,000–24,999 sq ft bracket ($0.07–$0.12/sq ft), crews require 3.60 to 5.54 ISSA labor hours per visit.

blocks.text: A **12,000 sq ft mid-rise suite** typically houses 65 to 95 staff across multiple departments, combining open workstation zones with a training room, executive hardwood boardroom, shared café, and **four or five restrooms**. While the **10,000–24,999 sq ft pricing bracket (`$0.07–$0.12/sq ft` base)** keeps per-square-foot labor efficient, two operational costs expand sharply at this footprint: **consumables (`$144–$300/visit`)** and **amortized quarterly deep floor care (`$360–$720/month`)**.

Below, we lay out the exact per-visit and monthly contract math for 4-restroom and 5-restroom mid-rise suites, quantify how paper and soap procurement affects annual spend, and map how schedules scale toward [15,000 sq ft](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-15000-sq-ft-office/) and [18,000 sq ft](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-18000-sq-ft-office/) corporate offices.
12,000 Sq Ft Mid-Rise Sanitation Schedule: 4 vs. 5 Restrooms

In mid-rise buildings, tenants either rely on core floor restrooms (commonly four rooms total) or maintain a fifth executive/client restroom inside the suite. At `$15 to $30` per restroom per visit, that fifth room adds **$195 to $390/month** on a 3x/week contract (`13.0 visits/month`) and **$325 to $650/month** on a 5x/week weekday schedule (`21.65 visits/month`), calculated strictly on **4.333 weeks per month**.

blocks.text: Supply Budgets, Add-Ons, and Flooring Multipliers at 12,000 Sq Ft

Once a suite hits 12,000 sq ft, **paper and soap consumables** (`$0.012 to $0.025/sq ft/visit`) become a major operating expense—adding **$144 to $300 per visit**, which equals **$1,872 to $3,900/month** at 3x/week or **$3,118 to $6,495/month** at 5x/week. Comparing bundled vendor supply pricing against direct wholesale purchasing is essential before signing.

blocks.text: *On a **3x/week** schedule with 5 restrooms, bundling breakroom sanitation (`+$12–$25/visit`), interior glass (`+$15–$35/visit`), consumables (`+$144–$300/visit`), and amortized quarterly deep floor care (`+$360–$720/mo`) brings totals from `$11,349–$19,734/month` to **$13,932–$25,134/month** (`$1,044–$1,878/visit`).

blocks.title: Audit Vendor Consumables Markups Before Bundling
blocks.text: At 12,000 sq ft, vendor-bundled paper and soap adds $3,118 to $6,495/month on a 5x/week contract. Many facility teams supply high-capacity coreless tissue, roll towels, and foam soap directly via corporate wholesale accounts while paying the cleaner strictly for labor, liners, and chemicals—trimming 15% to 25% off supply spend.
Crew Hours, Freight Elevators, and Regional Metro Rates

Under ISSA production standards (`2,800 to 4,000 sq ft/hr` plus `0.15 to 0.25 hrs` per restroom), a 12,000 sq ft mid-rise suite requires **3.60 to 5.29 labor hours** with four restrooms or **3.75 to 5.54 labor hours** with five restrooms (`3.43 hrs` floor pass at 3,500 sq ft/hr). In multi-tenant towers, freight-elevator cutoffs and security badging often dictate a **3-person night crew working 1.5 to 2.0 hours** rather than a lone cleaner.
High-Capacity Floor Hardware for 12,000 Sq Ft Mid-Rise Suites

Mid-rise suites spanning 12,000 sq ft need high-capacity dual-tank mopping, wide lobby dust sweeping, and hardwood-safe flat pads alongside dual commercial backpack vacuums (see our [Atrix VACBP1 vs. Powr-Flite BP6S comparison](/commercial-vacuums-and-floor-machines/atrix-vacbp1-vs-powr-flite-bp6s-backpack-vacuum/)):

items: **Unger Commercial 15-Gallon Dual-Bucket SmartColor System:** Separates fresh cleaning solution from dirty rinse water in a 15-gallon red/blue dual-tank chassis so multi-restroom tile and corridors stay free of gray re-soiling.

**Rubbermaid Commercial 36-Inch Cotton Dust Mop Frame & Handle:** Pairs a 36-inch swivel-360 head with a 60-inch handle to clear long 12,000 sq ft corridors and elevator lobbies rapidly before wet mopping.

**Bona Commercial System Multi-Surface Hardwood Mop Kit:** Provides an 18-inch heavy-duty aluminum base with telescoping handle and washable dusting/wet microfiber pads tailored for executive hardwood boardrooms.

blocks.title: Mid-Rise Building COI, Union/Shift Rules, and OSHA Mandates
blocks.text: Mid-rise property managers enforce strict vendor onboarding: expect a Certificate of Insurance ($1M/$2M General Liability naming tenant and building ownership as Additional Insured, statutory Workers' Compensation, and fidelity bond), freight-elevator scheduling compliance, OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS binders, and Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) certification.
5 Steps to Structure a 12,000 Sq Ft Sanitation & Supply Budget

items.text: Request a standalone consumables quote ($144–$300/visit) so you can benchmark vendor dispenser refills against corporate wholesale buying.

items.text: Budget $360 to $720/month amortized ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/mo) for hot-water extraction, VCT scrubbing, and hardwood conditioning.

faqs.q: What is the typical monthly cost to clean a 12,000 sq ft office?
faqs.a: At the 1.00x US national average on commercial carpet, a 12,000 sq ft suite with four restrooms averages $11,154 to $19,344/month at 3x/week ($858–$1,488/visit) and $17,666 to $30,656/month at 5x/week ($816–$1,416/visit). With five restrooms, 3x/week runs $11,349 to $19,734/month ($873–$1,518/visit) and 5x/week runs $17,991 to $31,306/month ($831–$1,446/visit).

faqs.q: How many crew hours per night does a 12,000 sq ft office require?
faqs.a: Based on ISSA production rates (2,800 to 4,000 sq ft/hr plus 0.15 to 0.25 hours per restroom), a 12,000 sq ft suite requires 3.60 to 5.29 labor hours with four restrooms or 3.75 to 5.54 labor hours with five restrooms—typically executed by a 3-person evening crew working 1.5 to 1.85 hours.

faqs.q: How much should a 12,000 sq ft office budget for consumables and deep floor care?
faqs.a: Vendor-supplied paper tissue, towels, soap, and trash liners add $144 to $300 per visit ($0.012–$0.025/sq ft/visit), totaling $1,872 to $3,900/month at 3x/week or $3,118 to $6,495/month at 5x/week. Amortized quarterly carpet extraction or VCT floor restoration adds $360 to $720/month ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/mo).

faqs.q: Why should mid-rise contracts specify 4.333 weeks per month and W-2 labor?
faqs.a: Multiplying weekly visits by 4.333 weeks/month (13.0 visits for 3x/week, 21.65 for 5x/week) prevents fifth-week billing disputes, while requiring W-2 payroll—backed by Workers' Compensation and a $1M/$2M General Liability COI naming tenant and building owner as Additional Insured—protects against joint-employer liability.

faqs.q: What green-cleaning and OSHA standards apply to a 12,000 sq ft mid-rise suite?
faqs.a: Contractors must maintain OSHA Hazard Communication (29 CFR 1910.1200) Safety Data Sheets and labeled bottles on site, follow OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) PPE rules for restroom biohazards, and use Green Seal GS-37 or EPA Safer Choice concentrated neutral cleaners with HEPA vacuum filtration if your mid-rise holds LEED certification.
